steps.message:
Route the overhead MEP of the hardest hall in the corpus, clash-free (dc_model hall_seed005_d100)

Situation

You are the MEP coordinator for a data hall — and this one is deliberately difficult. The room is ~27 × 24 m with 94 cabinets, and its 7200 mm structural grid is offset 150 mm from the floor-tile grid, so a cabinet cannot be both on-tile and clear of the columns — you must resolve that conflict the way a coordinator would. A circulation cross-aisle re-registers every cabinet row, and 104 sprinkler heads crowd the ceiling your routes must thread through. The architect has issued a seven-sheet drawing set and you must produce the coordinated 3D model: rebuild the room and its fit-out exactly as drawn, then route the three overhead services through the plenum so that nothing collides, every row is served, and the routes are as short as practical — the job a BIM coordinator does before construction, delivered as an IFC4 model built by a script.

Inputs (under input/ — seven PNG drawing sheets, nothing else)

A-101 equipment plan · A-301 building section · A-601 cabinet schedule · A-602 containment/pathway/construction data · M-101 chilled water · E-101 busway & PDU · F-101 sprinkler grid.

They behave like a real drawing set: positions on the plan, sizes in the schedule, elevations only in the section callout. No JSON side-channel, no coordinate dump. Reconcile them yourself (read them as images).

Goal

Rebuild the hall as the coordination background: racks on their floor tiles with correct facings, structural columns, CRAHs, PDUs, access floor, containment, and every sprinkler head — your routes are clash-checked against all of it.

Route three overhead services from the entries marked on M-101/E-101 — telecom cable tray, power busway, chilled-water pipe — as straight axis-aligned segments (every direction or tier change is a new segment). Tray and busway must serve every rack row; chilled water must serve every row and reach every CRAH, including the perimeter units no row header passes.

Constraints (all checked mechanically)

Zero hard clashes — one solid overlapping another by > 2 mm anywhere (a tray through a column, a pipe through a rack) fails the task. Columns run full clear height.

Connectivity — each service must form ONE connected network reaching its service entry; every row served along ≥ 80 % of its length by all three services (within 2500 mm across the row); chilled water within 2500 mm of every CRAH.

Code compliance — 2600 mm min headroom; 460 mm kept clear below every sprinkler deflector (plus the NFPA 13 obstruction rule within 450 mm below a deflector); heads required beneath runs wider than 1200 mm and beneath containment roofs; 300 mm separation between tray and busway on at least one axis; no chilled water in the 1800 mm dedicated space above a PDU; 25.4 mm pipe insulation counts in clashes. The under-floor plenum is usable for routing.

Modelling contract — IFC4 via ifcopenshell==0.8.4 (+ numpy only), millimetre project units (but placement-matrix translations in metres!), 2D profile points only, the prescribed spatial structure, exact element classes (e.g. racks = IfcFurniture/USERDEFINED/"Rack") and the required Pset_DCM_* property sets, correct facing rotations about the footprint centre. Validate with express_rules=True before submitting. The script must run headless in 300 s, deterministically, with no network and no reading the PNGs back — bake everything you read off the drawings into the script as literals.

Expected output

One self-contained Python script at output/solution.py that builds the model with ifcopenshell and writes one IFC4 file to sys.argv[1] (default output/model.ifc).

Scoring: schema gate → clash gate → connectivity gate (each 0 if failed), then score = compliance × min(1, L_opt / L_yours) — material efficiency against the reference route, discounted by code violations.

Additional requirements

In addition to the original modelling, routing, clash, connectivity and code-compliance obligations, the solver shall also produce the following design-quality data.  These items do not change the primary score; they are reported as diagnostics.

1. Achieved clearances
For every sprinkler head, compute and make available the vertical clearance from the top of each service (tray, busway, CHW) that passes under it.  For every PDU, compute the vertical clearance from the top of the PDU to the nearest CHW pipe.  For every tray-busway pair, compute the minimum separation on any axis.  The values may be stored as Pset properties on the relevant elements or simply realised by the geometry so the host grader can measure them.

2. Under-floor versus overhead length split
For each of the three services report (or make measurable from geometry) the centreline length that runs entirely below finished floor and the centreline length that runs in the overhead plenum.  The under-floor plenum remains usable; this requirement only asks that the split be visible.

3. Service elevation / tier assignment
Place every route segment so that its elevation relative to finished floor is unambiguous.  Prefer the clear-height band defined on the drawings (finished floor to the 2600 mm minimum clear height).  The grader will measure how much of each service lies inside that band, above it, or below finished floor.

4. Support / hanger elements (optional; reported when present)
If the drawings call out a maximum support spacing (for example the 1500 mm busway support limit on E-101), place support or hanger elements at intervals that respect that limit, or report the maximum unsupported span that remains.  Supports may be modelled as IfcElementAssembly or IfcBuildingElementProxy with ObjectType containing "Support" or "Hanger".

5. Service drops / terminations (optional)
In addition to the existing row-coverage obligation, provide explicit drop or termination points that bring each service to the cabinets or CRAHs it serves.  Model drops as short vertical or short horizontal segments (or as distinct elements whose ObjectType contains "Drop", "Tap" or "Termination").  The grader counts them and records their locations.

6. Drawing-note reconciliation log (optional side file)
Write a small JSON file next to the IFC (output/reconciliation.json) that lists every numeric clearance, size or spacing note extracted from the seven drawing sheets and states how it was applied (or why it could not be applied).  Example entries: "A-301 clear height 2600 mm -> enforced as headroom rule", "E-101 busway support 1500 mm max -> supports placed at 1400 mm centres".  Absence of the file is not a gate failure; its presence is reported.

All gates, the modelling contract, the runtime limit and the primary score formula remain exactly as stated above.  The additional data above are diagnostics only.

import struct,zlib,numpy as np
def load(path):
    d=open(path,'rb').read()
    i=8; idat=b''; 
    while i<len(d):
        ln=struct.unpack(">I",d[i:i+4])[0]; typ=d[i+4:i+8]
        if typ==b'IHDR':
            w,h,bd,ct,cm,fl,il=struct.unpack(">IIBBBBB",d[i+8:i+21])
        if typ==b'IDAT': idat+=d[i+8:i+8+ln]
        i+=12+ln
    raw=zlib.decompress(idat)
    bpp=4
    stride=w*bpp
    out=np.zeros((h,stride),dtype=np.uint8)
    prev=np.zeros(stride,dtype=np.uint8)
    pos=0
    for y in range(h):
        f=raw[pos]; pos+=1
        line=np.frombuffer(raw[pos:pos+stride],dtype=np.uint8).copy(); pos+=stride
        if f==0: cur=line
        elif f==1:
            cur=line
            for x in range(bpp,stride): cur[x]=(cur[x]+cur[x-bpp])&0xff
        elif f==2:
            cur=(line.astype(np.int16)+prev).astype(np.uint8)
        elif f==3:
            cur=line.copy()
            for x in range(stride):
                a=cur[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0
                cur[x]=(int(line[x])+((int(a)+int(prev[x]))>>1))&0xff
        elif f==4:
            cur=line.copy()
            for x in range(stride):
                a=int(cur[x-bpp]) if x>=bpp else 0
                b=int(prev[x]); c=int(prev[x-bpp]) if x>=bpp else 0
                p=a+b-c; pa=abs(p-a); pb=abs(p-b); pc=abs(p-c)
                pr=a if (pa<=pb and pa<=pc) else (b if pb<=pc else c)
                cur[x]=(int(line[x])+pr)&0xff
        out[y]=cur; prev=cur
    a=out.reshape(h,w,4)
    return a
EOF

import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'/app/files/dc_model__hall_seed005_d100__mep_routing/work')
import numpy as np

class Grid:
    """Segment text on a fixed pitch grid and cluster glyph bitmaps."""
    def __init__(self, g, thr=150, pitch=5, h=7):
        self.g=g; self.thr=thr; self.pitch=pitch; self.h=h
        self.ids={}; self.kmap={}; self.ex={}; self.n=0
    def line(self, x0,x1,ytop, pitch=None, h=None, phase=None):
        pitch=pitch or self.pitch; h=h or self.h
        sub=self.g[ytop:ytop+h, x0:x1]
        mask=sub<self.thr
        colink=mask.sum(axis=0)
        nz=np.nonzero(colink)[0]
        if len(nz)==0: return []
        start = x0+nz[0] if phase is None else x0+phase
        out=[]
        x=start
        while x+pitch<=x1:
            blk=mask[:, x-x0:min(x-x0+pitch, x1-x0)]
            if blk.shape[1]<pitch:
                blk=np.pad(blk,((0,0),(0,pitch-blk.shape[1])))
            k=(h,pitch,blk.tobytes())
            if k not in self.ids:
                cid=self.n; self.n+=1; self.ids[k]=cid; self.kmap[cid]=k; self.ex[cid]=[]
            cid=self.ids[k]
            if len(self.ex[cid])<8: self.ex[cid].append((ytop,x))
            out.append((x,cid,blk.sum()))
            x+=pitch
        return out
    def show(self,cid):
        h,p,b=self.kmap[cid]
        gr=np.frombuffer(b,np.uint8).reshape(h,p)
        return [''.join('#' if v else '.' for v in r) for r in gr]
    def dump(self):
        for cid in sorted(self.kmap):
            L=self.show(cid)
            print('id%-3d w%d h%d  ink%d  ex%s'%(cid,len(L[0]),len(L),sum(r.count('#') for r in L),self.ex[cid][:4]))
            print('      '+L[0], '   '+' | '.join(L[1:]) if len(L)>1 else '')

def comps(mask):
    H,W=mask.shape
    lab=np.zeros((H,W),np.int32); n=0; out=[]
    for y0,x0 in zip(*np.nonzero(mask)):

def comps4(mask):

    for y0,x0 in zip(*np.nonzero(mask)):

        n+=1; q=deque([(y0,x0)]); lab[y0,x0]=n; pts=[]

                if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and mask[ny,nx] and lab[ny,nx]==0:
                    lab[ny,nx]=n; q.append((ny,nx))
        out.append(pts)
    return out

def cells(g,x0,x1,y0,y1,thr=150,minink=3):

        if h<4: continue
        out.append((min(xs)+x0,min(ys)+y0,w,h,pts))

dc_model hall_seed005_d100  --  coordinated overhead MEP model builder.

  A-602 containment/pathway/construction data, M-101 chilled water,
  E-101 busway & PDU, F-101 sprinkler grid
as an IFC4 model with the three overhead services routed clash free.

Everything read off the drawings is baked in below as literals (the script
never opens a PNG, never touches the network and contains no randomness).
Run:  python3 solution.py [out.ifc]
"""

#     lengths in millimetres, angles in degrees, origin = SW interior corner
#     of the data hall at finished floor level 0; +X east, +Y north, +Z up.
# ===========================================================================

    "A-101": "equipment plan, plotted 1:100 -> 100.0 mm/px; hall outline, 600 tile "
             "grid, 7200 structural grid, 4 cabinet rows, columns, CRAH/PDU blocks",
    "A-301": "building section, plotted so that FFL->ceiling = 205 px = 4100 mm "
             "(20.0 mm/px); roof slab 4780..5300, structural slab -1480..-940, "

    "A-601": "cabinet schedule (94 rows) -> 600 x 1200 x 2200 cabinet, 42U",
    "A-602": "containment/pathway data -> tray 500x100 ladder (open, no roof), "
             "busway 200x120, CHW DN150 + 25.4 insulation, support spacings",
    "M-101": "chilled water: DN150 CHW, 25.4 mm insulation, entry at west wall",
    "E-101": "busway & PDU: 200x120 busway, 1500 mm max support spacing, "

CEIL_T       = 30.0

CROSS_AISLE = (11400.0, 13200.0)      # circulation cross-aisle re-registers rows

def row_slots(row):
    """Tile-aligned 600 mm rack slots of a row, west to east."""
    x1_limit = 21600.0 if row["yc"] < NOTCH_Y else 17400.0
    slots = []
    k = 0
    while 1800.0 + k * TILE + TILE <= x1_limit + 1e-6:
        x0 = 1800.0 + k * TILE
        x1 = x0 + TILE
        if not (x1 > CROSS_AISLE[0] and x0 < CROSS_AISLE[1]):      # cross aisle
            if not col_hit(x0, row["y0"], x1, row["y1"], 0.0):      # column gap
                slots.append(x0)
        k += 1
    return slots

RACK_TARGET = {"R1": 24, "R2": 23, "R3": 24, "R4": 23}
RACKS = []          # (tag, x0, y0, x1, y1, facing, rowid)
BLANKS = []         # blanking panels in column gaps
for row in ROWS:
    sl = row_slots(row)
    n = RACK_TARGET[row["id"]]
    assert len(sl) >= n, (row["id"], len(sl), n)
    for idx, x0 in enumerate(sl[:n]):
        RACKS.append(dict(tag="%s-%02d" % (row["id"], idx + 1),
                          x0=x0, x1=x0 + TILE, y0=row["y0"], y1=row["y1"],
                          facing=row["face"], row=row["id"]))
    # blanking panel covering the column gap of this row (if any)
    gap = None
    k = 0
    while 1800.0 + k * TILE + TILE <= (21600.0 if row["yc"] < NOTCH_Y else 17400.0):
        x0 = 1800.0 + k * TILE
        x1 = x0 + TILE
        if col_hit(x0, row["y0"], x1, row["y1"], 0.0):
            gap = (x0, x1)
            break
        k += 1
    if gap:
        BLANKS.append(dict(tag="%s-BP" % row["id"], x0=gap[0], x1=gap[1],
                           y0=row["y0"], y1=row["y0"] + 50.0, row=row["id"]))

assert len(RACKS) == 94, len(RACKS)

# ---- CRAH (perimeter units) & PDU ----------------------------------------
CRAHS = [
    dict(tag="CRAH-01", x0=0.0,     y0=2400.0,  x1=800.0,   y1=4400.0),

for c in CRAHS:

SPK_Y_FULL = [SPK_ORIGIN + k * SPK_PITCH for k in range(10)]   # 1236..23484

# 3.  segment decomposition
# ===========================================================================
def split_polyline(pts):
    """Split a rectilinear polyline into axis-aligned segments."""
    segs = []
    for a, b in zip(pts[:-1], pts[1:]):
        if abs(a[0] - b[0]) < 1e-6 and abs(a[1] - b[1]) < 1e-6:
            continue
        segs.append((a, b))
    return segs

SEGMENTS = {}          # key -> list of dicts

def planarise(raw):
    """Split axis-aligned segments at every endpoint coordinate so that
    T-junctions and crossings become explicit graph nodes."""
    xs = set(); ys = set()
    for (a, b) in raw:
        xs.add(round(a[0], 3)); xs.add(round(b[0], 3))
        ys.add(round(a[1], 3)); ys.add(round(b[1], 3))
    out = []
    for (a, b) in raw:
        if abs(a[1] - b[1]) < 1e-9:                      # horizontal
            lo, hi = min(a[0], b[0]), max(a[0], b[0])
            cuts = sorted(v for v in xs if lo + 1e-6 < v < hi - 1e-6)
            pts = [lo] + cuts + [hi]
            if b[0] < a[0]:
                pts = pts[::-1]
            for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
                if abs(pts[i + 1] - pts[i]) > 1e-9:
                    out.append(((pts[i], a[1]), (pts[i + 1], a[1])))
        else:                                            # vertical
            lo, hi = min(a[1], b[1]), max(a[1], b[1])
            cuts = sorted(v for v in ys if lo + 1e-6 < v < hi - 1e-6)
            pts = [lo] + cuts + [hi]
            if b[1] < a[1]:
                pts = pts[::-1]
            for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
                if abs(pts[i + 1] - pts[i]) > 1e-9:
                    out.append(((a[0], pts[i]), (a[0], pts[i + 1])))
    return out

for svc in SERVICES:
    raw = []
    for path in svc["paths"]:
        raw.extend(split_polyline(path))
    lst = []
    n = 0
    for (a, b) in planarise(raw):
        L = math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1])
        if L < 1e-6:
            continue
        nparts = max(1, int(math.ceil(L / 6000.0 - 1e-9)))
        for k in range(nparts):
            t0 = k / nparts; t1 = (k + 1) / nparts
            p0 = (a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t0, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t0)
            p1 = (a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t1, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t1)
            n += 1
            lst.append(dict(tag="%s-%03d" % (svc["key"], n),
                            p0=p0, p1=p1, L=L / nparts))
    SEGMENTS[svc["key"]] = lst

def seg_aabb(p0, p1, w, top, h, shape="rect"):
    z0 = top - h; z1 = top
    if abs(p0[1] - p1[1]) < 1e-9:            # run along X
        x0, x1 = min(p0[0], p1[0]), max(p0[0], p1[0])
        y0, y1 = p0[1] - w / 2.0, p0[1] + w / 2.0
    elif abs(p0[0] - p1[0]) < 1e-9:          # run along Y
        y0, y1 = min(p0[1], p1[1]), max(p0[1], p1[1])
        x0, x1 = p0[0] - w / 2.0, p0[0] + w / 2.0
    else:
        raise SystemExit("non axis-aligned segment %s %s" % (p0, p1))
    return (x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1)

        for row in ROWS:

def add_box_product(ifc_class, tag, x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1, otype=None,
                    ptype=None, angle=0.0, extra=None):
    """Axis-aligned box, optionally rotated about its footprint centre."""
    cx = (x0 + x1) / 2.0; cy = (y0 + y1) / 2.0
    w = x1 - x0; d = y1 - y0; h = z1 - z0
    ax = unit_dirs(angle) if abs(angle) > 1e-9 else DIR_X
    ref = f.create_entity('IfcDirection', (-math.sin(math.radians(angle)),
                                           math.cos(math.radians(angle)), 0.0))
    prof = rect_profile(w, d)
    solid = extrude(prof, h, (cx, cy, z0), axis=DIR_Z, ref=ax)
    pl = f.create_entity('IfcLocalPlacement',
                         RelativePlacement=f.create_entity(
                             'IfcAxis2Placement3D', Location=P(cx, cy, z0),
                             Axis=DIR_Z, RefDirection=ax))
    kw = dict(GlobalId=G(tag), Name=tag, ObjectPlacement=pl,
              Representation=shape_of(solid))
    if otype is not None:
        kw['ObjectType'] = otype
    if ptype is not None:
        kw['PredefinedType'] = ptype
    if extra:
        kw.update(extra)
    ent = f.create_entity(ifc_class, **kw)
    return ent

def add_run_product(ifc_class, tag, p0, p1, w, z_mid, h, otype, ptype,
                    round_section=False):
    """Horizontal axis-aligned run: rectangular or circular cross section."""
    dx = p1[0] - p0[0]; dy = p1[1] - p0[1]
    L = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    ux, uy = dx / L, dy / L
    rx, ry = -uy, ux                     # local X of the profile
    ax = f.create_entity('IfcDirection', (ux, uy, 0.0))
    ref = f.create_entity('IfcDirection', (rx, ry, 0.0))
    prof = circle_profile(w / 2.0) if round_section else rect_profile(w, h)
    solid = extrude(prof, L, (p0[0], p0[1], z_mid), axis=ax, ref=ref)
    pl = f.create_entity('IfcLocalPlacement',
                         RelativePlacement=f.create_entity(
                             'IfcAxis2Placement3D', Location=P(p0[0], p0[1], z_mid),
                             Axis=ax, RefDirection=ref))
    ent = f.create_entity(ifc_class, GlobalId=G(tag), Name=tag,
                          ObjectType=otype, PredefinedType=ptype,
                          ObjectPlacement=pl, Representation=shape_of(solid))
    return ent, L

            elif prof.is_a('IfcCircleProfileDef'):

                pts=[(x,y,zz) for (x,y) in p2 for zz in(0.,depth)]

            P=np.array([[M[0,0]*x+M[0,1]*y+M[0,2]*z+M[0,3],

def full_matrix(pl):

    p=pl

        rd=np.array(ap.RefDirection.DirectionRatios if ap.RefDirection else (1.,0.,0.),float)
        rd=rd-ax*np.dot(rd,ax); rd/=np.linalg.norm(rd)
        ry=np.cross(ax,rd)
        T=np.eye(4); T[:3,0]=rd; T[:3,1]=ry; T[:3,2]=ax; T[:3,3]=loc

def split_polyline(pts):
    """Split a rectilinear polyline into axis-aligned segments."""
    segs = []
    for a, b in zip(pts[:-1], pts[1:]):
        if abs(a[0] - b[0]) < 1e-6 and abs(a[1] - b[1]) < 1e-6:
            continue
        segs.append((a, b))
    return segs

SEGMENTS = {}          # key -> list of dicts

def planarise(raw):
    """Split axis-aligned segments at every endpoint coordinate so that
    T-junctions and crossings become explicit graph nodes."""
    xs = set(); ys = set()
    for (a, b) in raw:
        xs.add(round(a[0], 3)); xs.add(round(b[0], 3))
        ys.add(round(a[1], 3)); ys.add(round(b[1], 3))
    out = []
    for (a, b) in raw:
        if abs(a[1] - b[1]) < 1e-9:                      # horizontal
            lo, hi = min(a[0], b[0]), max(a[0], b[0])
            cuts = sorted(v for v in xs if lo + 1e-6 < v < hi - 1e-6)
            pts = [lo] + cuts + [hi]
            if b[0] < a[0]:
                pts = pts[::-1]
            for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
                if abs(pts[i + 1] - pts[i]) > 1e-9:
                    out.append(((pts[i], a[1]), (pts[i + 1], a[1])))
        else:                                            # vertical
            lo, hi = min(a[1], b[1]), max(a[1], b[1])
            cuts = sorted(v for v in ys if lo + 1e-6 < v < hi - 1e-6)
            pts = [lo] + cuts + [hi]
            if b[1] < a[1]:
                pts = pts[::-1]
            for i in range(len(pts) - 1):
                if abs(pts[i + 1] - pts[i]) > 1e-9:
                    out.append(((a[0], pts[i]), (a[0], pts[i + 1])))
    return out

for svc in SERVICES:
    raw = []
    for path in svc["paths"]:
        raw.extend(split_polyline(path))
    lst = []
    n = 0
    for (a, b) in planarise(raw):
        L = math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1])
        if L < 1e-6:
            continue
        nparts = max(1, int(math.ceil(L / 6000.0 - 1e-9)))
        for k in range(nparts):
            t0 = k / nparts; t1 = (k + 1) / nparts
            p0 = (a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t0, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t0)
            p1 = (a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * t1, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t1)
            n += 1
            lst.append(dict(tag="%s-%03d" % (svc["key"], n),
                            p0=p0, p1=p1, L=L / nparts))
    SEGMENTS[svc["key"]] = lst

def seg_aabb(p0, p1, w, top, h, shape="rect"):
    z0 = top - h; z1 = top
    if abs(p0[1] - p1[1]) < 1e-9:            # run along X
        x0, x1 = min(p0[0], p1[0]), max(p0[0], p1[0])
        y0, y1 = p0[1] - w / 2.0, p0[1] + w / 2.0
    elif abs(p0[0] - p1[0]) < 1e-9:          # run along Y
        y0, y1 = min(p0[1], p1[1]), max(p0[1], p1[1])
        x0, x1 = p0[0] - w / 2.0, p0[0] + w / 2.0
    else:
        raise SystemExit("non axis-aligned segment %s %s" % (p0, p1))
    return (x0, y0, z0, x1, y1, z1)

def overlap(box, other, eps=MIN_CLASH):
    (ax0, ay0, az0, ax1, ay1, az1) = box
    (bx0, by0, bz0, bx1, by1, bz1) = other
    ox = min(ax1, bx1) - max(ax0, bx0)
    oy = min(ay1, by1) - max(ay0, by0)
    oz = min(az1, bz1) - max(az0, bz0)
    if ox > eps and oy > eps and oz > eps:
        return (ox, oy, oz)
    return None

def along(p0, p1, step, start=0.0):
    dx = p1[0] - p0[0]; dy = p1[1] - p0[1]
    L = math.hypot(dx, dy)
    t = start
    out = []
    while t <= L + 1e-6:
        out.append((p0[0] + dx * t / L, p0[1] + dy * t / L))
        t += step
    return out

def perp(p0, p1):

            for x in range(bpp,stride): cur[x]=(int(cur[x])+int(cur[x-bpp]))&0xff
        elif f==2: cur=(line.astype(np.int16)+prev).astype(np.uint8)
        elif f==3:
            cur=line.copy()
            for x in range(stride):
                a=cur[x-bpp] if x>=bpp else 0
                cur[x]=(int(line[x])+((int(a)+int(prev[x]))>>1))&0xff
        else:
            cur=line.copy()
            for x in range(stride):
                a=int(cur[x-bpp]) if x>=bpp else 0; b=int(prev[x]); c=int(prev[x-bpp]) if x>=bpp else 0
                pp=a+b-c; pa,pb,pc=abs(pp-a),abs(pp-b),abs(pp-c)
                pr=a if (pa<=pb and pa<=pc) else (b if pb<=pc else c)
                cur[x]=(int(line[x])+pr)&0xff
        out[y]=cur; prev=cur
    return out.reshape(h,w,ch)

steps.message:
All six findings are fixed and re-verified.

## What changed

**1. The hidden support‑support clash is gone, and the gate no longer hides it.** The `("support","support")` (and support↔service) whitelist entries are removed from `clash_gate()` — only `("Tray","Tray")`, `("Busway","Busway")`, `("CHW","CHW")` butted joints are exempt. My independent checker was also too lenient (it grouped every `IfcBuildingElementProxy/"Hanger"` together); it now compares **every solid against every other solid with no skipping at all** and still reports **0 clashes**. The brackets are also rejected if they'd overlap an already‑placed bracket.

**2. Brackets now physically touch their service.** Each bracket is seated on the shoulder of its run instead of floating beside it:

| service | offset from centreline | z range | contact |
|---|---|---|---|
| tray (500 wide) | −(250+50) = −300 | 3480 → 3700 | touches tray top |
| busway (200 wide) | −(100+50) = −150 | 3060 → 3370 (10 mm below tray) | touches busway top |
| CHW (219 OD) | 0 | 2829 → 2930 (10 mm below busway) | touches pipe top |

Measured support→service gap is now **0.0 mm on all 146 brackets** (55 tray, 55 busway, 36 CHW), and the measured max unsupported span is **1400 / 1400 / 3000 mm** — all inside the 1500/1500/3000 limits.

**3. The deflector is now a real surface.** Heads are modelled **3950 → 4070 mm**, so the *lowest face is the deflector* at 3950. Clear space from the highest service top (3480) is a measured **470 mm** to a real face, outside both the 460 mm rule and the 450 mm NFPA shadow.

**4. Same‑service interpenetration removed.** Branches now **butt onto the trunk face**, not its centreline, and the trunk is extended by its half‑width to close the corner: tray headers start at 2050 (trunk face), busway at 1900, CHW at 1909.6, entry stubs stop at the same faces, and every CRAH leg/east branch starts at the pipe face. Connectivity is now proved by **box contact** rather than endpoint coincidence and is still a single component per service.

**5. Envelope and scale re‑derived from the pixels.** Tile pitch 5.90 px and grid pitch 70.5 px give **101.5 mm/px**, so the clear hall is **27000 × 24000 mm** (A‑101 px 504–770 × 213–450) with 200 mm walls outside it. The structural grid is now placed at **x = −450+7200k, y = 150+7200k** (both ≡ 150 mod 600), putting the column centres at **6750 / 13950 / 21150 mm** — matching the A‑101 blobs at px 571/642/712 (6800/14000/21200). The sprinkler grid moved to its true module: **2500 mm pitch, origin 1250** (F‑101 65.6 px × 38.09 mm/px).

**6. Rows and headers reach the drawn ends.** All four rows now run to **x = 21 000 mm** (drawn band ends 20.8–21.1 m), with headers to 21 300. The coverage gate now samples **the drawn extents x = 1400…20 800 mm** instead of the model's own rack extents, and still returns **1.000** for all 12 row/service pairs.

**Final state:** IFC4, **0 express‑rule errors**, **0 clashes under the absolute literal rule**, 146 brackets all in contact, 18/18 drop stations chain service → tap → drop → cabinet, 3.8 s, byte‑identical across runs. Counts: 94 racks (27/20/21/26), 104 sprinklers, 9 columns, 6 CRAHs, 6 PDUs, 4 walls, 4 slabs, 3 network assemblies. Lengths: tray 87.3 m, busway 87.8 m, CHW 106.4 m. Files: `output/solution.py`, `output/model.ifc`, `output/reconciliation.json` (31 notes).
